about.title: About
about.goal1: Coi Nè is a set of learning games for children of 3 to 5 years old. "Coi nè!" means "Look at this!". Small children say it when they find something new.
about.goal2: Children learn through curiosity and play. Vietnamese is the main language, and English is a tap away.
about.goal3: The folk games help the child know the games that the parents played as children in Vietnam.

story.oanquan.1: Long ago, in a village in Vietnam, children played under the big banyan tree.
story.oanquan.2: They drew a board on the ground and picked up small pebbles. The game is Ô ăn quan.
story.oanquan.3: Now you can play Ô ăn quan with Sỏi!
oanquan.practice: Tap a square in the bottom row. Then choose a direction. Let's count the pebbles!
oanquan.yourTurn: Your turn. Tap a square in the bottom row with pebbles.
oanquan.chooseDir: Which way do you want to go? Tap an arrow.
oanquan.notYours: This square is for Sỏi. Choose a square in the bottom row.
oanquan.emptySquare: This square has no pebbles. Choose another one.
oanquan.soiTurn: Now it is Sỏi's turn. Sỏi thinks a little.
oanquan.continue: The next square has pebbles. Pick them up and go on!
oanquan.stopQuan: The next one is a quan. The turn ends.
oanquan.stopEmpty: Two empty squares. The turn ends.
oanquan.refill: This row has no pebbles. Put one pebble in each square.
oanquan.refillBorrow: There are not enough pebbles. Borrow some from the other player.
oanquan.practiceAgain: Let's set up the board again.
oanquan.end: Both quans are empty! Let's count the pebbles.
oanquan.stoneNote: The big stone of a quan counts as ten pebbles.
oanquan.resultKidWins: You have more pebbles. You win this game! Sỏi is happy to play with you.
oanquan.resultSoiWins: Sỏi has a few more pebbles. You played very well! Let's play one more game?
oanquan.resultTie: It is a tie! You both played well.

story.taptamvong.1: In the village, children liked to play Tập tầm vông.
story.taptamvong.2: One child hides a pebble in one hand and sings. The other child guesses which hand has the pebble.
story.taptamvong.3: Now Sỏi hides a candy. You guess!
taptamvong.show: Look at this! Sỏi has a candy.
taptamvong.hide: Sỏi hides the candy in one hand.
taptamvong.watchHand: The candy is in this hand. Watch carefully!
taptamvong.watchCup: The candy is under this cup. Watch carefully!
taptamvong.askHand: Which hand has the candy? Tap a hand.
taptamvong.askCup: Which cup has the candy? Tap a cup.
